name: Akairo Kimi to, Shiawase ni
original_name: あかいろきみと、しあわせに
source:
Let's go find our happiness. Carefully, so we don't drown in this red twilight.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25530]Freem![/url]]
translation:
让我们一起去寻找我们的幸福吧。小心一点，免得我们淹没在这红色的暮色中。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25530]Freem![/url]]
